items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Chick Webb who is a super drummer.

ctx.x: Oh, I am glad to hear that. And the one thing I wanted to bring out about Davey. Davey's concept was the same as Chick's or people like that, you know. His concept was that drums were the heart of the band. The heart of the band. Correct?
Yes, there's no doubt about it. If the man were the artist Dave Tough is. Chick Webb who is a super drummer.
And should be the heart of the band, is really Davey's concept.
